mergedParams.userDescription: Chromatic aberration and prismatic splits. internal effects for text, video, images

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset for RGB channel splitting that simulates classic chromatic aberration. The effect should separate red, green, and blue channels with offset animations, creating a glitchy prismatic split. Use generic AnimationRange effects to animate three separate color channels with different translateX/Y offsets and opacity blending. The effect should accept parameters for split intensity (0-50px offset range), duration (default 1000ms), and direction (horizontal/vertical/diagonal). Implement smooth easing curves that create a subtle breathing effect where channels drift apart and converge. Target components using provider mode with configurable targetIds. The effect should work universally on text, images, and video elements by manipulating CSS filters and transforms.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: translateX, translateY, filter (hue-rotate for color channel simulation). Structure: Three parallel effects for R/G/B channels, each with offset keyframes at prog [0, 0.5, 1] using ease-in-out easing. Input params: { intensity: number (0-50), duration: number, direction: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'diagonal', targetIds: string[] }. Return format: { effects: [redChannelEffect, greenChannelEffect, blueChannelEffect] }. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Design a waveform-reactive chromatic aberration effect that responds to audio beats. The prismatic split intensity should pulse with bass frequencies, creating dynamic RGB channel separation synchronized to music. Use waveform effects with bass detection to modulate the chromatic split amount. Implement a shake effect combined with color channel offsets that intensify on beat hits. The effect should include threshold controls for beat sensitivity and maximum split distance. Add a decay parameter that controls how quickly the aberration returns to normal after a beat. Perfect for music videos and dynamic content where the visual distortion should react to audio energy.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (audio-reactive). Waveform config: { type: 'shake', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 0.8, threshold: 0.6 }. Combined with generic filter effects for RGB splitting. Input params: { maxSplit: number (10-100), decayTime: number (100-500ms), sensitivity: number (0-1), targetIds: string[] }. Return format: { effects: [waveformShake, chromaticFilter] }. Uses useWaveformData hook for audio analysis. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { presets: [] } }.

prompts.prompt: Build a prismatic refraction effect that creates rainbow-like color dispersions at element edges. The effect should simulate light passing through a prism by applying graduated color shifts and subtle distortions. Use AnimationRange to create multiple overlapping color layers with different hue rotations and blend modes. Each layer should have slightly offset timing to create a cascading rainbow effect. Include parameters for refraction angle (determines color spread direction), intensity (number of color layers), and shimmer (adds subtle animation). The effect should use CSS filters creatively to achieve realistic light dispersion without heavy performance costs.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: filter (hue-rotate, contrast, saturate), opacity, transform (skew for distortion). Creates 5-7 color layers with progressive hue-rotate values (0°, 60°, 120°, 180°, 240°, 300°). Each layer animates with prog [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] using spring easing. Input params: { angle: number (0-360), intensity: number (3-10 layers), shimmer: boolean, duration: number }. Return format: { effects: [...colorLayers] }. Mode: 'provider' with targetIds. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Develop a glitch-style chromatic aberration that creates digital corruption effects. The effect should randomly offset RGB channels with jittery movements and occasional dramatic splits. Implement using generic effects with randomized keyframe positions to simulate digital interference. Add scan lines and pixel-sorting artifacts alongside the chromatic splits. Include parameters for glitch frequency (how often dramatic splits occur), maximum aberration distance, and corruption style (analog vs digital). The effect should feel unpredictable but controlled, perfect for cyberpunk aesthetics or error state animations.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with randomized AnimationRange. Properties: translateX, translateY, filter (contrast, brightness), clipPath for scan lines. Keyframes use random prog values between 0-1 for jittery motion. Implements custom easing with step functions for digital feel. Input params: { glitchFrequency: number (0-1), maxAberration: number, style: 'analog' | 'digital', seed: number for reproducibility }. Return format: { effects: [mainGlitch, scanLines, pixelSort] }. Uses Math.random() with seed for controlled randomness. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Create a spectrum prism effect that splits content into a full rainbow spectrum animation. The effect should decompose the target element into multiple color-shifted copies that fan out like light through a prism, then reconverge. Use AnimationRange to orchestrate complex multi-layer animations where each spectral copy follows a unique arc path. Include bezier curve calculations for smooth arcing motions. Parameters should control spectrum width (how far colors spread), arc height (curvature of paths), and stagger timing (delay between each color's movement). Ideal for logo reveals or dramatic text entrances.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: translateX, translateY (following bezier paths), rotate, filter (hue-rotate), opacity. Creates 7 spectrum layers (ROYGBIV). Each follows cubic-bezier path with prog [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1]. Input params: { spectrumWidth: number, arcHeight: number, staggerDelay: number, duration: number, targetIds: string[] }. Path calculation: Uses quadratic bezier for smooth arcs. Return format: { effects: [...spectrumLayers] }. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Design an audio-reactive prismatic pulse effect where chromatic aberration blooms outward from the center on each beat. The effect should create concentric rings of color separation that ripple outward like sonar waves. Use waveform effects to detect beats and trigger expanding chromatic rings. Each pulse should have decreasing intensity as it expands, with newer pulses overlaying older ones. Include frequency-based color shifting where different audio frequencies affect different color channels. Parameters for pulse speed, maximum radius, and frequency sensitivity. Perfect for visualizers and music-driven content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform + Generic hybrid. Waveform config: { type: 'scale', audioProperty: 'waveform', sensitivity: 0.9 }. Generic effects for radial chromatic expansion using scale and filter properties. Implements ring buffer for multiple concurrent pulses. Input params: { pulseSpeed: number, maxRadius: number, frequencyMap: { bass: 'red', mid: 'green', treble: 'blue' }, targetIds: string[] }. Return format: { effects: [waveformTrigger, ...chromaticRings] }. Uses requestAnimationFrame for smooth ring expansion. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Build a lens distortion effect with chromatic fringing at edges, simulating real camera lens aberration. The effect should be strongest at element boundaries and fade toward center, creating authentic optical distortion. Use AnimationRange with radial gradients in CSS filters to achieve position-based aberration intensity. Implement barrel or pincushion distortion alongside the chromatic effects. Include parameters for distortion type (barrel/pincushion), aberration strength, and vignetting intensity. The effect should subtly breathe or pulse to add organic movement to static content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: filter (custom SVG filters for distortion), transform (scale for barrel/pincushion), maskImage (radial gradient for edge effects). Keyframes at prog [0, 0.33, 0.66, 1] with sine-wave easing for breathing. Input params: { distortionType: 'barrel' | 'pincushion', aberrationStrength: number (0-1), vignetteIntensity: number, breatheRate: number }. Custom SVG filter for authentic lens distortion. Return format: { effects: [lensDistortion, chromaticFringe, vignette] }. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Develop a holographic chromatic effect that creates iridescent color shifts based on viewing angle simulation. The effect should animate through different viewing angles, causing rainbow reflections to sweep across the surface. Use complex AnimationRange patterns to rotate through hue-shifts while adding metallic sheen effects. Include interference patterns that create thin-film optics appearance. Parameters for hologram intensity, color cycle speed, and metallic finish strength. The effect should make any content appear like a holographic sticker or security foil.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: filter (hue-rotate, brightness, contrast, saturate), background (linear-gradient for iridescence), mixBlendMode. Complex keyframe sequence at prog [0, 0.1, 0.2, ..., 1] for smooth color cycling. Input params: { intensity: number, cycleSpeed: number, metallicStrength: number, interferencePattern: 'waves' | 'circles' | 'lines' }. Uses CSS custom properties for dynamic gradient generation. Return format: { effects: [hologramBase, iridescence, interference] }. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Create a data-corruption style chromatic glitch that simulates damaged video codecs. The effect should create horizontal bands of chromatic separation that shift and tear like corrupted video frames. Use AnimationRange to create scan-line based aberrations with different intensities per line. Implement datamoshing-inspired color bleeding where previous frame colors persist in glitched areas. Include parameters for corruption severity, scan line density, and color persistence. The effect should feel like watching a damaged VHS tape or corrupted digital stream.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with line-based processing. Properties: clipPath (horizontal bands), filter (RGB channel splits per band), transform (translateX for tear effects). Creates 10-20 horizontal bands with individual AnimationRanges. Input params: { corruptionLevel: number (0-1), scanLineDensity: number, colorBleed: boolean, tearIntensity: number }. Uses CSS repeating-linear-gradient for scan lines. Return format: { effects: [...scanLineBands, colorBleedEffect] }. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Design a crystalline prism effect that fractures content into geometric shards with chromatic edges. The effect should create a shattered glass appearance where each fragment has its own chromatic aberration based on angle and position. Use AnimationRange to animate fragment separation and reformation with different color shifts per shard. Implement voronoi or delaunay tessellation patterns for realistic crystal fractures. Parameters for shard count, explosion radius, and chromatic intensity at fracture edges. Perfect for dramatic transitions or shatter effects with prismatic beauty.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with geometric decomposition. Properties: clipPath (polygon shards), transform (translate/rotate per shard), filter (hue-rotate based on shard angle). Generates 15-30 polygonal fragments using voronoi algorithm. Each shard has unique AnimationRange with prog [0, 0.4, 0.6, 1] for explosion/reformation. Input params: { shardCount: number, explosionRadius: number, chromaticEdgeWidth: number, tessellationPattern: 'voronoi' | 'delaunay' | 'triangular' }. Return format: { effects: [...shardEffects] }. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.
